decisions.reason: As a next-generation high-resolution inkjet printer, it sits squarely in the firm's core marking technology base, so absorptive capacity is high and management would likely continue improving rather than withdraw it.

This numbering software module closely complements the firm's installed printing systems and traceability offering, though as a narrower software add-on it has a somewhat higher chance of being folded into other solutions than core hardware.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces directly extends the firm's existing coding, ink and application know-how, making it a strong fit with both customer needs and the firm's learning base.

The decoding app is more adjacent to the firm's traditional machinery business, but as a successor to an earlier app and a useful element in digital traceability it is still close enough to the firm's knowledge base to justify retention.

Inline code verification strongly matches the firm's move toward compliance, serialization and end-to-end traceability, and it leverages its established expertise in industrial identification systems.

Print layout design software fits the firm's common-operation and integrated-solution strategy, although software products can be more easily merged or repositioned within a broader platform than flagship equipment.
